name: Input Data 7
definition: Information related to an input request.

DeviceType.name: Device Type
DeviceType.definition: Type of logical device located on a Sale Terminal or a POI Terminal.

InformationQualifier.name: Information Qualifier
InformationQualifier.definition: Qualification of the information to output to the logical device.

NotifyCardInputFlag.name: Notify Card Input Flag
NotifyCardInputFlag.definition: Flag of notification of card to be entered in the POI card reader.

InputText.name: Input Text
InputText.definition: Text value set for an input command.

ImmediateResponseFlag.name: Immediate Response Flag
ImmediateResponseFlag.definition: Flag to request Immediate response without waiting for the completion of the command.

WaitUserValidationFlag.name: Wait User Validation Flag
WaitUserValidationFlag.definition: Flag to confirm by the user the entered characters, when the maximum allowed length is reached.

BeepKeyFlag.name: Beep Key Flag
BeepKeyFlag.definition: Flag to indicate that when the user press a key, a beep has to be generated.

GlobalCorrectionFlag.name: Global Correction Flag
GlobalCorrectionFlag.definition: Flag to correct all characters (True) or just the last one (False).

DisableCancelFlag.name: Disable Cancel Flag
DisableCancelFlag.definition: Flag to deactivate the "Cancel" function key.

DisableCorrectFlag.name: Disable Correct Flag
DisableCorrectFlag.definition: Flag to deactivate the "Correct" function key.

DisableValidFlag.name: Disable Valid Flag
DisableValidFlag.definition: Flag to disable the "Valid" function key.

MenuBackFlag.name: Menu Back Flag
MenuBackFlag.definition: Flag to enable the "Back" function key to go the upper level.
